title: Saves and backups
summary: Keep your campaign safe and get it back when something breaks.

sections.heading: Saving
steps: Press Save game on the Dashboard any time. The server saves the campaign right away.
Set Autosave interval (minutes) on Settings so it saves by itself.
Save before you stop or restart, so nobody loses progress.

sections.heading: Backups
steps: Press Backup now on the Dashboard or on Saves. It zips this world's save into the Save Backups folder.
To go back, pick the save on Saves and press Load backup.
Open save folder on Saves shows where the saves are.

sections.heading: When a save breaks
steps: Start server fixes known save problems by itself and shows what it fixed. Run Rescue save on the Logs page runs every fix once.
Last good save puts back the newest save from before a hero lost their party.
sections.tip: Make a backup before you try new mods. It takes a second and can save your whole campaign.
